snippet.title: Geareo Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Geareo is launching into Early Access on December 10, 2026!

Get ready to build, experiment, and engineer your own machines in Geareo, a mechanical engineering sandbox where your imagination sets the limits.

Early Access will bring new ways to experience Geareo, including a campaign mode and building instructions to guide you through constructing different machines.

Whether you want to follow guided builds, experiment with mechanical systems, or create something completely ridiculous, there’s plenty to explore.

❤️ A huge thank you to our amazing community, especially the creators whose incredible builds we featured in the trailer.

Your creativity and support help make Geareo what it is today!
Try the free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4411580/Geareo/

Subscribe for more updates, and get ready to build!

#Geareo #EarlyAccess #IndieGame #Sandbox #Engineering #Steam
